scenes.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: quiz: spot the bug
scenes.animation: Butter banner drops in with a buzzer; wrong code shakes; the Python error lines appear in tomato; the fix slides in and the terminal turns mint with a ding
scenes.narration: Final quiz. Spot the bug. We remove every even number from the list, and print. We expect an empty list. We get four and eight. The loop walks the list by position. When we remove an item, the next one slides into its place, and the loop jumps over it. Never change a list while looping over it. Build a new list with a comprehension instead.

props.fixedCode:
nums = [2, 4, 6, 8]
nums = [n for n in nums if n % 2 != 0]
print(nums)
props.why: Removing items from a list while looping over it shifts the remaining items, so the loop skips some. Build a new list with a comprehension instead.
